statement: ∃ (a : ℂ) (s : Finset ℂ), a ≠ 0 ∧ a ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ∧ s.Nonempty ∧ Submodule.span (Chevalley.R p) (s : Set ℂ) = Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 ∧ (q : ℂ) * a = z
proof:
classical
let J := Chevalley.J p M y v 0
let L := Chevalley.QJ p M y v
have hJ : J ≠ ⊥ := h_T010.1.2.2.1
obtain ⟨a, ha, ha0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hJ
have haL : a ∈ L := Submodule.subset_span ha
have haL0 : (⟨a, haL⟩ : L) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hh
  exact ha0 (congrArg Subtype.val hh)
have hdim : Module.finrank ℚ L = 1 := h_T010.2.2.2.2.2
have hline : ∀ z ∈ J, ∃ q : ℚ, (q : ℂ) * a = z := by
  intro z hz
  have hzL : z ∈ L := Submodule.subset_span hz
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' (K := ℚ) (⟨a, haL⟩ : L) haL0).mp hdim ⟨z, hzL⟩
  exact ⟨q, by simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using congrArg Subtype.val hq⟩
obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h_T010.1.2.1
let s := t.erase 0
have hs : Submodule.span (Chevalley.R p) (s : Set ℂ) = J := by
  change Submodule.span (Chevalley.R p) ((t.erase 0 : Finset ℂ) : Set ℂ) = J
  rw [Finset.coe_erase, Submodule.span_sdiff_singleton_zero]
  exact ht
have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
  by_contra he
  have hempty : s = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp he
  rw [hempty] at hs
  exact hJ (by simpa using hs.symm)
refine ⟨a, s, ha0, ha, hsne, hs, ?_⟩
intro z hz
have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hz).1
have hzJ : z ∈ J := hs ▸ Submodule.subset_span hz
obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hline z hzJ
refine ⟨hz0, q, ?_, hq⟩
intro hq0
apply hz0
simpa [hq0] using hq.symm

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    ((∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), Chevalley.J p M y v ↑i = Chevalley.J p M y v 0) ∧
          (Chevalley.J p M y v 0).FG ∧
            Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ≠ ⊥ ∧
              ∀ (u : V),
                u ∈ Chevalley.image p M ↔
                  ∃! c,
                    (∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), c i ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0) ∧ u = ∑ i, c i • Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
        (Function.Injective ⇑(Chevalley.qmul p M y v) ∧
            (Chevalley.qmul p M y v).range = Chevalley.QJ p M y v ∧
              FiniteDimensional ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) ∧
                FiniteDimensional ℚ ↥(Chevalley.QJ p M y v)) ∧
          Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] Chevalley.MR p M) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            ell.toNat + 1 = (ell.toNat + 1) * Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) ∧
              Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[↥(Chevalley.R p)] ↥(Chevalley.J p M y v 0)) = 1 ∧
                Module.finrank ℚ ↥(Chevalley.QJ p M y v) = 1 →
      ∃ a s,
        a ≠ 0 ∧
          a ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ∧
            s.Nonempty ∧
              Submodule.span ↥(Chevalley.R p) ↑s = Chevalley.J p M y v 0 ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, z ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ q, q ≠ 0 ∧ ↑q * a = z
